title: Inclusive range sum
prompt: Write sum_inclusive(a, b) that returns the sum of all integers from a to b, both ends INCLUSIVE. a <= b.
reference_solution:
def sum_inclusive(a, b):
    return sum(range(a, b + 1))
teacher_lesson: When the task says the end is inclusive, iterate range(a, b + 1); range() excludes the end.
